apk.notes: Scan Cards on the phone (a photo of the cards → Incoming Product lines; a shop owner sets it up in Settings → Card Scanner with the shop's Ximilar key). Description 1 is now the card name and number ("Charizard ex 223/197") and Description 2 the set, for Upload TCG Player CSV, pasting TCGplayer columns and Scan Cards alike.

web.notes: The light red Certification # reminder now also turns on when Con/Grade/Sealed starts with PSA, BGS, CGC, TAG or SGC.

desktop.notes: Another shop on this computer: Settings → Another Shop on This Computer → Make a Separate Copy… makes a copy of the program in its own folder, with its own data and sign-in, that runs alongside this one (to set up or help another shop).
